headword: {在宅医療|ざいたくいりょう}

definitions.gloss: home healthcare — medical care provided to patients at their own home, by visiting doctors, nurses, or other medical professionals
definitions.explanation: Medical care delivered at a patient's home rather than in a hospital or clinic, typically through scheduled visits by doctors ({往診|おうしん}) and nurses ({訪問|ほうもん}{看護|かんご}). Especially important for elderly people with chronic illnesses, patients recovering after discharge, and terminal patients receiving palliative care.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{在宅|ざいたく}→在宅：07696_zaitaku⟧ ('being at home') and ⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧ ('medical care').

USAGE:
- Refers to a care model in which medical professionals visit patients at home, as opposed to the patient going to a hospital or clinic.
- A key concept in Japan's aging-society healthcare policy; closely tied to ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{包括|ほうかつ}→包括：11931_houkatsu⟧⟦ケア→ケア：10848_kea⟧ ('community-based integrated care').
- Distinct from ⟦{在宅|ざいたく}{介護|かいご}→在宅介護：18931_zaitakukaigo⟧ ('home care/nursing'), which focuses on daily-living assistance rather than medical treatment, though the two are often combined in practice.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {在宅医療|ざいたくいりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive home medical care
- {在宅医療|ざいたくいりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提供|ていきょう}する→提供する：21736_teikyousuru⟧: to provide home medical care
- {在宅医療|ざいたくいりょう}⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧: the home healthcare system
- {在宅医療|ざいたくいりょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}える→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧: to switch to home healthcare

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{往診|おうしん}→往診：08209_oushin⟧: house call (by a doctor) — a component of {在宅医療|ざいたくいりょう}; a single visit rather than an ongoing model of care.
- ⟦{訪問|ほうもん}→訪問：03622_houmon⟧⟦{看護|かんご}→看護：13668_kango⟧: visiting nursing — a related nursing service; also often part of {在宅医療|ざいたくいりょう}.
- ⟦{在宅|ざいたく}{介護|かいご}→在宅介護：18931_zaitakukaigo⟧: home care, home nursing care — focuses on daily-living support (bathing, feeding, etc.) rather than medical treatment.
- ⟦{通院|つういん}→通院：05975_tsuuin⟧: going to a hospital/clinic for treatment — the usual contrast.
